bills.title: National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Getting the NDIS Back on Track No. 1) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted in favour of a motion "*that, in schedule 1, items 3, 19, 20, 47 and 124, and section 32H in item 36, stand as printed, and item 14 of schedule 1 stand as amended"*. In other words, they voted to keep those items unchanged. This motion was put after the Greens Party introduced amendment sheets [2733](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7181_amend_24af88b3-a445-4b72-8294-4a614362f6e1%22;rec=0) and [2734](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7181_amend_a56aa07f-b4e2-409b-9545-480b13def2f7%22;rec=0) which proposed that those items be opposed.
